channel.title: Changelog | RemNote
channel.description: Vote or request new RemNote features. Subscribe to get updates about new features from RemNote. - Powered by RSSHub

item.description:
Bugfixes

  • YouTube Viewer: Fix loading transcripts

  • Image Occlusion: Fix occlusion areas not applying in the queue

Improvements & Bugfixes

  • All Notes Page: Improved the document list on mobile to update more quickly.

  • Simple Tables: Changed the Tab key to the Space key for auto-filling table cells.

  • Search: Added substring highlighting when using Ctrl+F.

  • Editor: Improved indentation display for RTL languages.

  • Search: Improved the ability to select content in the Ctrl+F input box when focused in the editor.

  • Sidebar: Improved the look and feel of the sidebar.

  • Simple Tables: Improved table cell borders to show only on full height.

  • Simple Tables: Improved table type switch buttons to only appear on primary tables.

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed the "Enable card" button being unclickable in advanced table cells.

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed column resize handler Y position.

  • All Notes Page: Fixed duplicate header section appearing on scroll.

  • Flashcards: Fixed the "Include All Nested Descendants" feature not working correctly.

  • Flashcards: Fixed missing border around the practice button on mobile.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed selection expansion with Shift+Arrow having no limit in simple tables.

  • Templates: Fixed dark mode color support.

  • Upload: Fixed upload popup being cut off when uploading inside a folder.

  • Document Popup: Improved loading state.

Improvements & Bugfixes

  • Editor: Added long press hold in select mode to trigger context menu on phone and tablet.

  • Graph Visualization: Revamped graph visualization.

  • Editor: Improved tab completion on multi-line and multiple choice questions.

  • Date Picker: Fixed selecting non-today dates in the date picker under Today's Notes.

  • Document Menu: Fixed document menu dark mode display issue.

  • Editor: Fixed double slash disabling flashcards incorrectly.

  • Infinite Canvas: Fixed onboarding drawing canvas becoming completely blank.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed opening some PDFs causing screen to flicker and PDF reader to reload.

  • Tables: Fixed delete property confirmation popup message.

  • Tables: Fixed table setting thumbnail image height.

  • Offline Knowledge Bases: Fixed issues loading local KBs.

New Features

  • RemNote Wrapped 2025!

Improvements

  • AI Tools: Added support for Gemini 3 and Claude 4.5 Opus in AI tutor chat.

  • AI Tools: Increased AI chat maximum input and output tokens.

  • Card Table: Polished various Card Table features and behaviors.

  • Card Table: Added additional Card Table polish and refinements.

  • Editor: Improved search highlight styling for better visibility.

  • Editor: Improved Ctrl-F search highlight navigation and added match counter.

  • Flashcards: Added remind me button to practice banner.

  • Flashcards: Changed date carousel to start the first day on Sunday.

  • PDF Viewer: Added reader zoom button tooltips.

Bugs

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed filtered table issue where creating multiline cells caused rows to disappear.

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed table cell icon size appearing very small.

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed RTL language support in tables.

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed zooming into table rows nested inside tags.

  • Android: Fixed rare issue causing crashes on database save.

  • Desktop: Fixed images not immediately downloading.

  • Edit Later: Fixed Edit Later section not appearing in sidebar unless refreshed.

  • Editor: Fixed need to tap twice to add a new rem on mobile.

  • Editor: Fixed spell-check squiggles appearing on top of images.

  • Editor: Improved update indicators throughout the interface.

  • Flashcards: Fixed text line height displaying incorrectly on queue.

  • Flashcards: Fixed inability to exit test in sequence card order popup without choosing an option.

  • Flashcards: Fixed images appearing very small on the Queue.

  • Handwritten Documents: Fixed handwritten documents getting stuck in editable mode.

  • Handwritten Documents: Fixed inconsistent text item rendering between Chrome and Safari.

  • iPad: Fixed language selection menu positioning issue.

  • Mobile: Fixed popup width not updating properly on orientation change and app state change.

  • Mobile: Fixed toasts rendering under bottom sheets.

  • PDF Viewer: Improved PDF summary generation to skip processing when all text is blank.

  • Search: Fixed "Animate Zooming" setting not working.

  • Search: Fixed close button disappearing when multiple panes are opened.

  • Syncing: Fixed syncing progress visually jumping back to 0%.

  • Zoom: Fixed zoom writing window not opening when clicking the button.

Improvements & Bugfixes

  • Flashcards: Added options to regenerate and give feedback on Correctness Insights.

  • Editor: Fixed LaTeX items shifting on hover.

  • Editor: Fixed paste from web page context menu not pasting the active cut selection.

  • Editor: Fixed replacing text over Ctrl+F highlight causing weird rendering.

  • Handwritten Documents: Fixed squiggle drawing items not rendered correctly after undo/redo

  • Tables: Fixed table tab-completion.

  • UI: Fixed focus issue on bottom right page number on iPad.

  • UI: Fixed incorrect scroll history when changing tabs.

Improvements & Bug Fixes

  • Editor: Enhanced Rem metadata screen for clearer information display.

  • Desktop App: Fixed zoom variable limits to prevent display issues.

  • Editor: Fixed keyboard shortcuts section missing from the settings button.

  • Handwritten Documents: Fixed drawing squiggle order to display strokes correctly.

  • iPad: Fixed controlled popup overlays being cut off on iPad screens.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed missing PDF URL errors that prevented documents from loading.

  • Print View: Fixed new sidebar gutter appearing incorrectly in print view.

  • Queue: Fixed double-clicking on images causing unintended behavior.

Improvements & Bugfixes

  • Today’s Note: Fixed the button that re-opens the current month to properly account for the year.

  • Export: Fixed export using the wrong knowledge base.

  • iOS Badge: Improved settings config.

  • iOS Widget: Fixed the widget showing logged out UI even when the user is logged in.

  • Translations: Fixed translation loading issues.

Bug Fixes

  • All Notes Page: Fixed the native document list on the home screen getting stuck in a loading state.

  • Daily Documents: Fixed buggy appearance when switching between other pages and a daily document.

  • iOS App: Fixed crash issue.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed pen colors displaying incorrectly in dark mode.

  • Templates: Fixed the template button appearing empty in the mobile app.

  • Templates: Fixed the daily template menu displaying incorrectly in dark mode on mobile.

Bug Fixes

  • Editor: Fixed cursor visibility issues in light mode.

  • Editor: Fixed multiple choice questions incorrectly marking option A as correct when copying and pasting questions with non-A correct answers.

  • Editor: Fixed images overlapping content when printing documents.

  • Queue: Fixed content overflowing on mobile devices.

  • Tables: Fixed inability to add or click bottom rows when the table reaches the bottom of the document.

Improvements & Bugfixes

  • Anki Import: Improved support for importing Anki decks in the new APKG format.

  • Handwritten Documents: Made mouse wheel zoom speed consistent at all zoom levels.

  • Handwritten Documents: Added an input box for font size in the edit settings popup.

  • Editor: Fixed images flickering the first time you hover over them.

  • Flashcards: Fixed forward/backward arrows on the flashcard home top navbar on iOS.

  • Handwritten Documents: Fixed copy paste functionality in the drawing canvas.

  • Handwritten Documents: Fixed zooming using the toolbar button to zoom around the canvas center.

  • Handwritten Documents: Fixed various drawing-related issues.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed date picker appearing on every document.

  • Syncing: Fixed syncing page vertical overflow when crashed or stuck.

  • Android: Optimized Android initial download.
